questions.question: Review the English treatment of chlen, club member versus series term. The rule retains members and Notes explains the double meaning; decide whether the wording about judging people by a few members reads naturally enough.

localizations.source: Review the English treatment of chlen, club member versus series term. The rule retains members and Notes explains the double meaning; decide whether the wording about judging people by a few members reads naturally enough.
localizations.ru: Проверить передачу игры слова «член» (член клуба / член ряда) в EN. В правиле оставлено members, а двойной смысл объяснён в примечании; решить, достаточно ли естественна реплика о людях по нескольким членам для английского читателя.
